card.name: Words around Abraham Lincoln and Civil War
card.fires_on: Verbs, commas and linking words in passages about Abraham Lincoln and the US Civil War, just before or after a name. Also seen once before a named official such as a director.

modes.label: Lincoln history text
modes.description: Linking word or comma next to Lincoln or Civil War figures such as Grant and Douglas.
modes.example: In 1865, President Abraham Lincoln<< and>> Confederate Vice President Alexander H. Stephens held

modes.label: Civil War army and command
modes.description: Small words before a named commander in Civil War text.
modes.example: Army of Virginia<< under>> Maj. Gen. John Pope.

card.writes: It pushes toward Republican and Senator-style tokens (Rep, Sen) and away from balance words.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in American Civil War and Lincoln passages, where a political name such as Republican or Senator could come next.
